definition: the front of the body below the chest
description: On a snowy race track in the mountains, a young man in a red jacket over a white top, black ski trousers and sunglasses is pulled along on short skis by a rope tied around the middle of his body, at his waist, fastened to the harness of a brown horse galloping beside him. He laughs and shouts with his arms spread wide, wobbles and spreads them again. Spectators stand behind a rope line, another rider follows on a horse, and snowy pine trees and a wooden cabin with a smoking chimney fill the background.

de.answer: Es ist um seine Körpermitte gebunden.
de.question: Wo ist das Seil festgebunden?
